zack-acme: hitting 503s from our Private cluster since ~03:20 UTC, intermittently. example req id: req_4f9d2a1a. latency also spikes (1.2-1.8s/token). Can you help collect a debug bundle?

alice.support: sorry you're hitting this — we can take a look. Quick Qs: which Private env (VPC name / cluster id)? do you have a repro curl that hits the failing endpoint? also pasting the request-id is perfect.

zack-acme: cluster: acme-prod-vpc-us-east-1, node pool name: redwood-prod-01. repro curl below (token redacted):

```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "X-Request-Id: req_4f9d2a1a" \
  "https://private.acme.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":50}'
```

zack-acme: run from our internal bastion, fails ~60% of requests.

michael-sre: thanks. For Private deployments we have a collector binary that gathers logs + configs + kernel traces. If you can run this on a node that has network access to the service (bastion or a control-plane host) it will produce a tarball with redaction enabled. Command (run as root or sudo):

```
sudo /opt/redwood/collector/bin/collector gather \
  --since "2026-03-16T03:00:00Z" \
  --request-id "req_4f9d2a1a" \
  --components api,serving,k8s,kvcache \
  --redact-pii \
  --redact-keys "authorization,access_token,private_key" \
  --kms-alias "projects/acme-kms/locations/global/keyRings/rw/cryptoKeys/rw-key" \
  --output /tmp/rw-debug-req_4f9d2a1a.tar.gz
```

michael-sre: that --redact-keys flag strips high-risk secrets from config files and the collector will replace values with REDACTED. If your deployment uses a customer KMS we will not be able to decrypt the key material server-side — collector will note the kms-alias in the bundle.

ingrid-priv: note for Private installs with no outbound internet: if the host cannot upload to our S3 endpoint, please SCP the tarball to your bastion and we can provide a secure upload endpoint or we can pull from a peered S3 path. If you want us to pull, provide an internal S3 URI and a role/credential with read access.

ingrid-priv: example scp (from bastion):
```
scp /tmp/rw-debug-req_4f9d2a1a.tar.gz support@uploads.redwood.ai:/incoming/acme-prod/
```
ingrid-priv: if you need a presigned PUT instead (preferred for direct uploads), say so and I'll generate one and DM you.

collector-bot: Collector run started on host redwood-prod-01. Gathering logs, system metrics, and kernel traces.

michael-sre: also collect kube logs (if applicable) or systemd logs. For k8s: run on control plane or use kubectl with the correct kubeconfig: 
```
kubectl --kubeconfig=/etc/rw/kubeconfig logs -l app=redwood-inference --since=2h --tail=500 > /tmp/k8s_pods.log
```

michael-sre: for systemd-based nodes: 
```
journalctl -u redwood-inference --since "2 hours ago" --no-pager > /tmp/service_journal.log
```

zack-acme: running collector now on bastion (has access to control plane). small heads-up: we saw this log snippet right before 503s: 
```
[2026-03-16T03:18:42Z] ERROR serving: failed to allocate kv cache entry: out of memory, evicting
[2026-03-16T03:18:42Z] WARN proxy: backend timeout after 10s
```

alice.support: perfect, that log snippet is very helpful. Once the collector finishes, please either upload to the presigned URL we'll provide or scp to uploads.redwood.ai. When uploading, include the request-id in the filename or metadata.

ingrid-priv: FYI please include the following metadata in your upload ticket: cluster id, node pool name, kubernetes version, approximate window of failures, and the request-id. We will redact the bundle on receipt and rotate any short-lived tokens we find.

collector-bot: Collector finished successfully. Bundle: /tmp/rw-debug-req_4f9d2a1a.tar.gz (size: 42MB). SHA256: 3b2f9c...

zack-acme: uploading now via presigned PUT (got the link via DM). upload id: upload_8b7f3.

ops-billing: ping — is there any billing-sensitive information in these bundles we should be aware of? we need to know for log retention policy.

alice.support: ops-billing we requested --redact-pii and --redact-keys, so tokens/keys should be masked. We still advise billing to avoid storing bundles in cheap/long-term tiers — short retention (30 days) by default.

alice.support: received upload_8b7f3, attaching to ticket RW-7821. Thanks for the quick repro steps and request-id. We'll start a targeted trace on the serving instances and update here. :thumbsup:

zack-acme: thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround.
